title: Aliens tell him they created humans and humanity is not ready

tellings.quote: dimensions. Your only achievement in civilization is that we created you, the intelligent beings here.

plain: In 1997, according to Kiran Ilum Xenov, a former president of one of Russia's republics, he was taken aboard an alien spacecraft and the beings there told him they had made humankind. He tells it as his own experience, recalling them saying that the only achievement of human civilization is that they created us as intelligent beings, and that humanity is not yet ready.
